text: A woman with long red hair, fair skin, and a curvaceous build sits on stone steps. She wears a sheer white gown with blue trim, revealing her torso. Her face is oval, with bold red lips and golden eyes. She rests one hand near her chin, the other on her thigh. A blue beaded necklace and bracelets adorn her neck and wrists. Behind her, ruins loom under a deep blue sky. The scene suggests post-apocalyptic decay.
